terms.gloss: pound, mash, or crush by blows
terms.comment: Lewis & Short includes olives, roots, and crushing/flattening injuries. The perfect has recorded quantity variation; contudī is left without a root-vowel macron here.

terms.gloss: grind or crush into small pieces

phrases.english: Crush the biscuits in the mortar.

phrases.latin: Mox rēticulum eximitō et arōmata in pīlā quam mundissimē contunditō
phrases.english: Then take out the little net and pound the spices in a mortar as cleanly as you can

sources: Lewis & Short: contundo · Lewis & Short: contero
